thread:
Maya: emergency home-office update  cat walked across my keyboard during a client call and then knocked my mic off the desk. decided to MacGyver a mic shield out of a sock and a cereal box. 0/10 glamorous but surprisingly quieter. :cat2: :sweat_smile:
Chen: socks are underrated acoustic panels tbh. soft fabric + shape helps. post a pic? :eyes:
Maya: posting in 2  quality very amateur.
Ralph: quick pro tip: stuff the sock with microfiber cloth or spare T-shirt to add absorption. you can cut the box into a semicircle and velcro it to a small stand.
Ivy: or buy a foam mic cover for $6 and pretend you planned it.
Maya: order placed. the sock-cereal setup is now named "The Muffler" and has a tiny sticky paw print on the corner from cat supervision.
Chen: ops-bot says quiet hours in the shared building lounge are ending at 9pm if you were considering switching rooms. ops-bot: FYI shared lounge reopens at 21:00 local; please be considerate. :bell:
Ralph: also, if your cat is a serial mic saboteur, try a cheap boom arm to keep it out of paw reach. changed my life.
Maya: will try boom arm next. for now, The Muffler and a stern look did the trick. will upload the glorious disaster photo later. :camera_with_flash:
